gather_optimizer_state_dict: gather the full or sharded optimizer state dict from an FSDP model for checkpointing
scatter_optimizer_state_dict: load and scatter a full or sharded optimizer state dict into an FSDP model
gather_ema_state_dict: gather the full or sharded EMA state dict from an FSDP model across all ranks
scatter_ema_state_dict: load a full or sharded EMA state dict into an FSDP model and restore model state
review_utils_checkpoint: review the FSDP checkpoint utility functions for optimizer and EMA state dict gathering and scattering
